decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - External brickwork,mortar, face-bond and pointing shall comply with Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
Condition : 4 - All joinery details shall comply with Technical Note 3 of  the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
Condition : 5 - Roofing details shall comply with Technical Note 4 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
description: Erection of a part single storey side extension, rear ground floor conservatory extension, erection of a rear dormer roof extension incorporating the creation of a roof terrace, internal alterations, and the installation of a new window at the first floor to the existing house.
